justification.forest: Two shallow depths and leaf sizes >=5; optional balanced weights; 100 seeded trees
justification.logistic: Three decade-spaced L2 strengths and optional training-fold balanced weights; fixed convergence tolerance
justification.simplicity: dummy before logistic before forest; stronger L2, shallower trees/larger leaves, and unweighted ties first

metric_definitions.average_precision: non-interpolated stepwise area; included to avoid overstating a constant dummy baseline
metric_definitions.variation: sample standard deviation across 5 outer folds, not an independent-patient confidence interval

preprocessing.categorical: OneHotEncoder auto, drop=None, handle_unknown=ignore, dense; vocabulary fitted on training fold

selection.final: unweighted mean of each candidate's 15 existing inner validation scores; outer-test metrics never participate
selection.outer_report: family-specific inner selections plus all-family inner selection procedure; not independent evaluation of the final all-development fit
selection.per_outer: choose only using that outer-training set's three inner validation scores
